verified_facts: Simple yet Stylish Esthetic: These ladies slippers’ classic double strap silhouette with cute furry faux fur never goes out of style - and they’re super easy to pair with every outfit, too. They are perfect wardrobe staple and bedroom slippers for women of any ages and styles

Comfortable Materials: These comfort-boosting open-toe slippers come together with premium sorted faux fur uppers and soft linings, lending a stylish yet pairing-with-anything finish. They are easy to maintain, hand and machine washable

High-density Memory Foam: Cloud-like memory foam and EVA footbed make these slippers super comfortable for all-day long. Over time, flexible memory foam will adjust to your feet for the ultimate customized fit and arch support. You can

Non-slip Sole. These fuzzy slippers can make you ease into various occasions. With anti-skid grips for good traction, the sturdy outsole is perfect whether you're picking up around the house, shopping in the market, or grabbing the morning paper

Size Tips & Delicate Gifts: If you have a standard or thin foot type, choose your usual size. For wider or higher feet, it's recommended to go one size up for extra comfort. Wrapped in boxes, these comfy slippers are perfect gift choice for your loved women on special days. We have size 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-10 and our sizes run a little bit small, so please refer to the size chart for a more accurate selection
